title: Graph planes q(graph A): fixed vectors (P1), normal estimate (Nor), the bounded graph parametrization and the difference identity
statement: For all n, l and every linear isometry (linear isometric equivalence) q of R^(n+l) = Amb n l. Here graphPoint(a, b) in R^(n+l) has first n coordinates a in R^n and last l coordinates b in R^l, and ||.|| is the operator norm. For continuous linear A : R^n -> R^l let G_A := q(span{graphPoint(v, A v) : v in R^n}), the submodule Submodule.map q (span (range (v -> graphPoint v (A v)))), and let P_A be its orthogonal projection (starProjection). Then: (P1) P_A(q(graphPoint(x, A x))) = q(graphPoint(x, A x)) for every x in R^n; (P2) |w| <= (1 + ||A||^2)^(1/2) |q(graphPoint(0, w)) - P_A q(graphPoint(0, w))| for every w in R^l; (W) there is a continuous linear W : R^n -> R^(n+l) with W v = q(graphPoint(v, A v)) for all v in R^n and ||W|| <= (1 + ||A||^2)^(1/2); (D) for continuous linear A, B : R^n -> R^l and v in R^n, q(graphPoint(v, A v)) - q(graphPoint(v, B v)) = q(graphPoint(0, (A - B) v)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n), (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint x (A x))) = q (graphPoint x (A x))) ∧ (∀ (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (w : Rn ℓ), ‖w‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2) * ‖q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) w) - (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) w))‖) ∧ (∀ A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ∃ W : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, (∀ v : Rn n, W v = q (graphPoint v (A v))) ∧ ‖W‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (v : Rn n), q (graphPoint v (A v)) - q (graphPoint v (B v)) = q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) ((A - B) v))
